title: 2002 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Horse
seo_title: 2002 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Horse (12 February – 31 January 2003)
description: 2002 is the Year of the Water Horse (Yang, Ren-wu), from 12 February 2002 to 31 January 2003. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2002.
lead: Born in 2002? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Horse, but check the date: the 2002 Water Horse year began on 12 February 2002. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2002: Year of the Water Horse, from 12 February 2002 to 31 January 2003.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2002 was the Year of the Horse. It began with Lunar New Year on 12 February 2002 and ended on 31 January 2003, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2002 ends in 2, which makes it a Water year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2002 is a Ren-wu year. The same Water Horse combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1942 before it and 2062 after it.
Lunar New Year 2002 fell on 12 February 2002, so everyone born in January 2002, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Snake.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Horse guide describes the sign like this: “Energetic, independent, and adventurous. Horses love freedom and new experiences.” The usual watch-out: “Can be impatient or struggle to commit long-term.”

The Water element adds its own flavour. Water years bring intuition, adaptability, and calm wisdom. People of this element tend to be thoughtful, diplomatic, and perceptive. Read more in our Water element guide, or the full Year of the Horse page.
Careers often linked with the Horse: travel, sales, sports, media.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2002
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Horse's best matches are the Tiger, Goat and Dog, and its clash sign is the Rat, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Horse, 2026 is a Horse year, so Horse people are in their own year (ben ming nian) until 5 February 2027.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Horse, it is listed as a supportive match of the Goat, so 2027 is traditionally a friendly year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Horse years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1978 (Earth Horse); 1990 (Metal Horse); 2014 (Wood Horse); 2026 (Fire Horse). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2002 is the Year of the Horse, a Yang Water Horse year (Ren-wu).
When does the 2002 Year of the Horse start and end?
It starts on 12 February 2002 and ends on 31 January 2003.
I was born in January 2002. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Snake: Lunar New Year 2002 was on 12 February 2002, so all of January 2002 belongs to the Snake year.
Water. 2002 ends in 2, which belongs to Water, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Horse compatible with?
Traditionally the Tiger, Goat and Dog. The Horse's clash sign is the Rat.
